system.effect:
Trigger: When the Pokémon enters the battlefield or an allied Dondozo is on the field at the beginning of its turn.

This Pokémon goes inside the mouth of Dondozo, issuing commands from there. This Pokémon is considered untargetable by all effects and abilities except recalling, and all non-AOE attacks. This Pokémon may attack as usual from within Dondozo, but may not activate its own abilities until it leaves Dondozos mouth as a standard action.

As long as this Pokemon is in Dondozo's mouth, Dondozo cannot switch out, and Dondozo gain's +2 CS in all stats.
